 WE ARE HIRING | LOGISTICS MANAGER
Are you experienced in Planning, Import–Export, Warehouse & Inventory Management and ready to take the next step in your career?
Kärcher Vietnam Technology is looking for a Logistics Manager to join our team in Nui Thanh, Da Nang, Vietnam.
 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Demand & Production Planning
• Review customer demand and forecasts and take necessary actions
• Review monthly production planning and coordinate with the Procurement team
• Monitor material fulfillment, inventory and production capacity
• Follow up on Assembly and Injection capacity
• Support the Planning team on escalated issues
Import–Export
• Update customs policies and relevant regulations
• Manage tax, duty, ocean freight, local and customs charges according to budget
• Support teams and other departments with customs processes and transportation solutions
• Coordinate transportation-related issues and the transport handbook
Warehouse & Inventory
• Manage the EWM system and coordinate with IT on system issues
• Review warehouse activities and identify improvement opportunities
• Support the Warehouse Supervisor on escalated issues
• Review safety stock, slow-moving items, consumption and inventory
 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Management or a related field
• Experience in Import–Export, preferably in a non-EPE manufacturing environment
• Experience in Planning, preferably in a manufacturing environment
• Experience in Warehouse & Inventory Management and team supervision
• Knowledge of SAP, EWM, ISO, EHS and 5S
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills
• High level of personal organization
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams
 OUR KÄRCHER WOW PACKAGE
 International, professional working environment
 Transportation, meal & phone allowances
 Premium private healthcare insurance
 Attractive salary & bonuses: Average annual compensation equivalent to 15 months’ salary, plus various other benefits
 Working hours: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
 Clear career advancement & training opportunities
 Location: Nui Thanh, Da Nang, Vietnam

Tùy năng lực và kinh nghiệm.
Có chính sách thưởng giữ sĩ số lớp theo năm.
ĐIỂM KHÁC BIỆT TẠI CONQUEST
Lịch giảng dạy ổn định 12 tháng, ngoài giờ hành chính.
Dạy theo khung chương trình và tài liệu có sẵn, không phải tự xây dựng chương trình hay soạn bài từ đầu.

Có TA/Học vụ hỗ trợ quản lý lớp, theo dõi học viên và chăm sóc phụ huynh.
Giáo viên tập trung vào giảng dạy và chất lượng học tập của học viên.

IELTS 7.5+, không kỹ năng nào dưới 6.5, chứng chỉ còn hiệu lực.
